source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)
pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (platform band vs frame 0: phase-correlation shift <=0.12 px in x, <=0.8 px in y, mean abs diff <=2.8 grey levels = noise)
camera.projection: perspective camera, side view, horizon not visible; car moves parallel to the image plane. Perspective parallax visible: near-side wheels move 28.23 px/frame while the car silhouette centre moves 27.29 px/frame; silhouette appears ~7-25 px longer near the image borders (3D car seen slightly from front/behind).

objects.name: car
objects.description: dark-red / burgundy classic sports coupe (Porsche 911 Turbo style, rear spoiler 'whale tail'), side view, facing +x (right)
objects.reference_point: centre of the silhouette bbox (bumper-to-bumper midpoint, vertical bbox middle); measured in frames 13-36, linear-fit extrapolation elsewhere
objects.motion: uniform horizontal motion to the right along the platform, no vertical motion (bbox bottom = 539 every full frame)

length_bumper_to_bumper.note: 428-429 at frames 13-14 and 36 (near borders, perspective), 420-422 near image centre (frames 19-34)

objects.name: platform
objects.description: long dark weathered stone/rusty-metal slab (bridge deck / ledge) the car drives on, spans the full image width; small rectangular brackets under its top lip; tapered ends at lower corners
objects.x_extent_px: full width 0-1079 at rows 541-580; lower tapered part x 36-1073 at y=590, x 82-1010 at y=615

objects.name: background
objects.description: plain white (segmentation replacement), no other objects

events.event: car already moving at constant speed when video starts, front part visible at left border
car fully enters view (rear bumper leaves left border)
car last visible (only rear bumper sliver)

events.note: no start/stop, bounce, contact change or direction change: uniform motion throughout
